info.title: Ray Admin API
info.description: Mock and real backends share this contract. Route component values are identifiers from the frontend view catalog, never executable code.

servers.description: Default demo base. Replace with VITE_API_BASE_URL for your backend.

path.description: Absolute or relative child path. Supports named and optional parameters.

name.description: Unique Vue Router name. Required for keepAlive.

component.description: Registered view ID. Use layout for a menu group.

alias.description: Absolute alternative path(s) for a leaf.

redirect.description: Absolute path of another configured page.

props.description: Pass route params (true) or a JSON object to the view.

i18nKey.description: Translation key for the menu title.

noLocalTitle.description: Literal title if i18nKey is absent.

role.description: Allowed roles. Omitted or empty means any authenticated role.

hidden.description: Hide from the menu. Direct navigation still uses the role guard.

sameLevel.description: Append a breadcrumb without replacing the current tab.

order.description: Menu sort order at the top level.

env.description: Vite mode(s) in which the menu item is visible.

windowOpen.description: Open this HTTP(S) URL in a new tab.

ignoreAutoResetScroll.description: Keep the content scroll position on navigation.

keepAlive.description: Keep the view mounted. name must match the registered view name.
